ns2:course.label: Special Problems
ns2:course.description: Investigative projects in speech and hearing not including theses. 1 to 8 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
